einzeiler: Celebrating 1900 episodes and grandparenthood with special guest host Rob Dew.
kurzfassung: Adam Curry and guest co-host Rob Dew celebrate the 1900th episode of the show while discussing recent news events. The conversation covers global financial strategies involving the US dollar and Iran, speculation around AI infrastructure and data centers, and various viral stories from social media. The episode also features listener donations and updates on worldwide community meetups.
stichpunkte: Adam Curry and Rob Dew celebrate 1900 episodes of the show on Adam's birthday.
Discussion centers on Scott Besson's economic policies regarding Iran and sanctions.
Analysis of widespread cloud and AI infrastructure outages affecting major tech companies.
Exploration of viral social media debates surrounding the Lindsey Clancy criminal trial.
Investigation into Bluetooth interference and surveillance concerns caused by Flock safety cameras.
Examination of data center booms, power consumption, and Jevons Paradox in AI.
Review of new evidence and whistleblower claims regarding the January 6th pipe bomb investigation.
Extensive acknowledgment of listener donations, producer titles, and global meetup announcements.

clips.text: The hosts discuss how modern grandparents prefer trendy nicknames over traditional titles like grandma.
Treasury official Scott Besson outlines aggressive secondary sanctions targeting foreign banking systems and entities doing business with Iran.

clips.hook: We are in a speculative bubble right now
clips.text: A former penetration tester explains that the massive race to build data centers is primarily driven by an artificial intelligence hype cycle before retail investors realize there is no substance behind it.

clips.hook: 186 phone numbers that pinged in the vicinity
clips.text: An analysis of official committee findings reveals that numerous mobile devices were active right near the placement of the Capitol pipe bombs, pointing to immediate electronic footprints.

clips.hook: I happen to be wearing the socks you gave me
clips.text: A listener from Japan sends birthday wishes while recounting how she wears custom socks gifted by the host a year prior.
